title: Area population and civic/health context (proposed enrichment bundle)
practical_value: User service-coverage area/period counts → boundary-aware statistical geography → population cohort → aggregate health/service indicators. Ask whether provision rates differ under matched denominators or where coverage gaps exist. Need service/civic indicators and denominator definitions, statistical territorial bridges and licensed aggregates. No individual health inference from regional values.
showcase_value: Choropleth and cohort comparison with denominator/methodology/uncertainty.
reason: All dependencies are research concepts; suitable dataset/recordset, identifier reconciliation, licensing and measured join dependencies remain open. Not selected, implemented or validated.
